before.name: Margaret Butler
before.description: Margaret Butler, born in Portland in 1957, was a Communications Workers of America activist who co-founded Portland Jobs with Justice in 1991 and later directed the coalition. During its 1993 National Day of Action for Labor Law Reform sit-in at the National Labor Relations Board offices, she was one of nine people arrested when police cleared the lobby. The accessible oral history does not give the exact arrest date, booking details, disposition or any period of confinement.
